sprint.title: Representative Bryn Shander Traversal Region and Topology Integrity
sprint.goal: Create a representative canon-informed Bryn Shander macro traversal graph that can be deterministically traversed and inspected for local topology integrity.
acceptance_criteria: The approved representative anchors and minimal connective geography form one reachable local graph.
All ordinary local connections are explicitly reciprocal; validation rejects missing targets, self-links, duplicate targets, missing reverse edges, and unreachable locations.
Loops and equal-hop alternate routes follow the Sprint 10.72 fewest-hop then authored-connection-order routing semantics.
Route selection remains static-topology-only, movement_hops remains transient, save version remains 1, and provider requests remain forbidden.

focused_commands: Full script-based regression suite including movement, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe coverage

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
No intentionally asymmetric local path or asymmetric-route schema is permitted.

No regional routing, costs, dynamic-state-aware routing, rerouting, route-choice interaction, encounters, parser expansion, persistence change, migration, scene projection, narration, or provider behavior is permitted.
Provider requests are forbidden and next_sprint remains null.

closeout.verification_result: Topology validation, deterministic routing, and the full script-based regression suite passed. No live provider request occurred. Save version remains 1 and next_sprint remains null.
